name: User account mutation guard
summary: Block direct local user, group, password, and privilege-assignment mutations.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate for explicit Unix, macOS, and Windows account-administration commands while allowing identity and membership inspection.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks direct local user, group, password, and privilege-assignment mutations; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not create, delete, rename, unlock, or modify local accounts.
It does not set, read, generate, or rotate account passwords.
It does not infer account authority from prompt text or command flags.

entrypoints.purpose: Recognize local account administration commands and refuse identity mutations.

linkReasons.hook/security/application-security/shell: user-account-mutation-guard cannot see hidden commands (e.g. bash -c "$X"): shell-command-guard stops them.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block direct local user, group, password, and privilege-assignment mutations without deferred work.
